description: Elementary Grades 3-5 deterministic misconception and remediation catalog. Each entry maps to a canonical mathematical concept and provides application-owned classification rules and remediation guidance.

misconceptions.name: Adds instead of multiplying equal groups
misconceptions.remediation: Model equal groups with arrays or counters; write repeated addition and then the matching multiplication sentence.

misconceptions.name: Confuses factor order in context
misconceptions.remediation: Label the number of groups and the size of each group before multiplying.

misconceptions.name: Always divides smaller digit from larger digit
misconceptions.remediation: Use equal-sharing models: divide the total into the stated number of equal groups.

misconceptions.name: Ignores or misinterprets remainders
misconceptions.remediation: Distribute counters and record the remainder; discuss what it means in the word-problem context.

misconceptions.name: Thinks commutative property does not apply to all multiplication
misconceptions.remediation: Build an array, rotate it, and show the product is unchanged.

misconceptions.name: Rounds only the leftmost digit
misconceptions.remediation: Locate the rounding place on a number line; look at the digit immediately to its right.

misconceptions.name: Treats numerator and denominator as separate whole numbers
misconceptions.remediation: Use fraction bars and number lines to show a fraction as one number located between 0 and 1.

misconceptions.name: Thinks equivalent fractions must use the same shape
misconceptions.remediation: Fold and overlay fraction strips to show equal area even with different numbers of parts.

misconceptions.name: Confuses area and perimeter formulas
misconceptions.remediation: Trace the boundary for perimeter; count unit squares inside for area; label units as linear or square.

misconceptions.name: Relies on appearance rather than attributes
misconceptions.remediation: Measure sides and angles; classify by defining attributes, not orientation or size.

misconceptions.name: Forgets place-value positions in partial products
misconceptions.remediation: Use an area model to decompose factors by place value and add partial products.

misconceptions.name: Divides each digit separately without place value
misconceptions.remediation: Use place-value disks or base-ten blocks to group and subtract divisor chunks.

misconceptions.name: Adds numerators and denominators
misconceptions.remediation: Use fraction strips to find a common denominator before adding or subtracting.

misconceptions.name: Thinks multiplication always makes numbers bigger
misconceptions.remediation: Compare a fraction of a quantity to the original quantity; model with fraction bars.

misconceptions.name: Aligns decimal points to the left instead of by place value
misconceptions.remediation: Use a place-value chart; line up decimal points before adding or subtracting.

misconceptions.name: Counts visible faces or cubes only
misconceptions.remediation: Build the prism with unit cubes layer by layer; count length × width × height.

misconceptions.name: Reverses x and y coordinates
misconceptions.remediation: Move along the x-axis first, then parallel to the y-axis; label each axis.
